lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data for December 2018 Haiti Near Term Projection represents spatial classification of food insecurity phases across administrative areas, capturing population-level food security impacts.
